title: The answer key records the $6,000 investment in unlabeled row 22 instead of the 'Investment in affiliate' row 23, which contradicts the sheet instruction. A correct solution that posts the investment to row 23 would fail.
evidence: Golden E22=6000 (=D10), F22=6000, H22=6000 with no label in C22. C3 says "Record the investment at the full purchase price in the 'Investment in affiliate' account" (row 23). Golden H23=0.
confirmation: Golden EquityMethod E22=D10 (6000), F22=6000 and H22=6000 sit in unlabeled row 22. F23 is empty and H23=SUM(F23:G23)=0, although C3 says to record the investment in 'Investment in affiliate' (row 23). An output that books it in row 23 mismatches the modified cells E22, F22 and H22.

title: The answer key never increases the investment account by the $3,900 of equity income, so year-end Total Assets does not equal Total L&E. A correct equity-method solution would mismatch the key.
evidence: Golden G23 is empty and H23=0. Golden H27=231500 but H33=235400, a $3,900 gap equal to D55. The correct H23 would be 6000+3900=9900, with Total Assets at 235400.
confirmation: Golden G23 is blank and H23=0, so H27 Total Assets=231500 while H33 Total L&E=235400. The 3900 gap equals the D55 equity income that was never added to the investment, so a balanced equity-method solution mismatches H23 and H27.
